categories.description: Weighted category definitions for each gender box, managed by the DirtyRank settings panel.

genderBoxes.description: Named groups of performer genders, each with independent categories and ratings. Managed by the DirtyRank settings panel.

defaultCohort.description: The default gender box used for battles and leaderboards.

enabledCohorts.description: Available gender boxes, managed by the DirtyRank settings panel.

showBattlesInMenu.displayName: Show Battles in the Stash header
showBattlesInMenu.description: Add a Battles button to Stash's utility navigation. Enabled by default.

showLeaderboardsInMenu.displayName: Show Leaderboards in the Stash header
showLeaderboardsInMenu.description: Add a Leaderboards button to Stash's utility navigation. Enabled by default.

leaderboardTopCount.description: Number of performers featured in the Podium, Mount Rushmore, or Fingers layout.

leaderboardView.description: Show full leaderboard standings as a Gallery or Table.

leaderboardPerformerCount.description: Total performers per page, including the featured top. Must be a multiple of 3 for Podium, 4 for Mount Rushmore, or 5 for Fingers, with at least two rows. Defaults to 18, rounded up for the selected layout.

overallScoreStrategy.description: Choose Simple weighted (default), Power mean, Rating strength or Proven rating strength. Applies to existing overall scores without changing category ratings or battle history.

overallPower.description: Emphasis on stronger category scores. 1 matches Simple weighted; 3 is the default for this strategy. Range 1 to 4, including decimals.

showRatingsBeforeVote.description: Reveal ratings and ranks before choosing a performer. Disabled by default to reduce bias.

hidePerformerImages.description: Remove performer profile images from battle cards. Disabled by default.

hideBattleStandings.description: Hide the right-hand standings and expand standard and Gauntlet battles. King of the hill always hides standings. Disabled by default.

autoPlayTopScenes.description: Open each performer's highest-rated full scene in battles, muted, at a random point between 30% and 70%. Disabled by default. Photos remain clickable for voting unless hidden.

includePerformersWithoutImages.description: Allow performers without a profile image to appear in battles.

confidenceGoal.description: Optimize information-gain matchmaking for every rating, leaderboard order, or a top-N leaderboard. Defaults to leaderboard order.

confidenceTopN.description: Number of top performers to stabilize when the top-N confidence goal is selected. Defaults to 20.

avoidRepeatWindow.description: Number of recent pairs to avoid when alternatives are available. Defaults to 12.

calibrationPercent.description: Percentage of matchmaking searches favouring broader rating gaps. A soft preference within the information-gain optimizer. Defaults to 10.

initialRating.description: Starting rating for a new category and cohort pool. Defaults to 1000.

initialDeviation.description: Starting uncertainty for an unrated performer. Defaults to 350.

evidenceWeight.description: Strength of one subjective comparison in the Glicko-2 update. 1 is standard evidence; 2 doubles the information contribution while recording one battle. Defaults to 2.

tau.description: Controls how quickly volatility may change. Defaults to 0.5.

deviationFloor.description: Minimum uncertainty retained for highly precise ratings. Defaults to 30.

provisionalDeviation.description: Ratings at or below this deviation are Refined; Excellent uses 60% of this threshold or the deviation floor, whichever is higher. Defaults to 85.

ratingPresets.name: Default
ratingPresets.description: Standard DirtyRank values. 2× evidence, 12 recent pairs avoided, 10% calibration, tau 0.5.

ratingPresets.name: Chess
ratingPresets.description: Lichess core Glicko-2 values. 1× evidence, 12 recent pairs avoided, 10% calibration, tau 0.75.

ratingPresets.name: Confident
ratingPresets.description: For consistent preferences. 2× evidence, 24 recent pairs avoided, 5% calibration, tau 0.5.

ratingPresets.name: Extremely confident
ratingPresets.description: Fewer battles for stable preferences. 3× evidence, 48 recent pairs avoided, 0% calibration, tau 0.3. Mistaken votes also carry more weight.
